name: Jester’s Skill
body:
Prerequisite(s): Wis 15, Jester class

Benefit(s): Choose a jester class skill that you are trained in. Each time you make a skill check using that skill, and you dislike the result, you may reroll the skill check. You must use the second result, even if it is lower.
